nodes.name: columns-flex-root-cause
nodes.summary: Kill the ghost grid: .columns was never actually flex
nodes.body:
Two earlier grid-to-flex edits had silently missed their anchor (the
rule's widths had drifted), so .columns stayed a 3-column grid the
whole time — five flex children crammed into three cells put the
review pane in the wrong column and dropped the inspector to a second
row. Diagnosed with a new layout probe in ISOMER_SHOT mode (dumps
bounding boxes and computed display), which also gains
ISOMER_SHOT_VIEW to force a landing view for captures. Every CSS
surgery in this round asserts its anchor now.

nodes.name: stack-history-review
nodes.summary: Make the trunk stack view reviewable, not decorative
nodes.body:
With no pending stack, the history cards used to be inert while the
review pane asked you to select a change — a dead end. Cards now
select: the review pane shows the picked commit's full highlighted
diff, the inspector filters comments by that commit's change identity
(and lets you add one), and the newest commit is selected on entry.
